messages:
maria_cs: FYI vendor intake flagged a doc ask from Acme Finance — they want DPA confirmation + a short KMS attestation and a dataflow diagram. Uploading the questionnaire.
support-bot: uploaded file dpa_kms_questionnaire_acme.pdf (shared in thread)
olivia_pm: timeline? customer says renewal review next week.
maria_cs: they asked for answers by EOD Thurs. Can we get a redacted key provenance + a one-page dataflow? Also need confirmation on nonprod access controls.
sanjay_security: I can draft a short attestation. quick clarifying q: do they need BYOK details or just that we use customer-isolated keys where requested?
liam_eng: we don't expose customer-managed CMKs by default. For Dedicated/Private we can provide guidance. Sample snippet for the attestation if helpful:
```
We use AWS KMS CMKs for encryption-at-rest. For Private deployments customers may provide BYOK; in Hosted, keys are managed by Redwood Inference with access controls, HSM-backed storage, and strict separation per tenancy.
Key ID samples are redacted in this response.
```
maria_cs: perfect — can you add a line about key rotation cadence? they asked about rotation and audit logs.
liam_eng: yep — add: "Keys are rotated annually or on-demand; access and rotation are logged to CloudTrail and retained per our retention policy." short and generic.
sanjay_security: I'll draft a 3-paragraph attestation and a redacted key provenance template. Maria — can you confirm whether Acme requires IP allowlist entries or just policy statements?
maria_cs: policy statement is fine for now, they'll escalate for IP allowlist if they need network peering. I'll push the questionnaire once we have the attestation draft.
olivia_pm: heads-up to sales: if they ask for BYOK we should loop infra/ops for timeline & costs.
maria_cs: noted, looping sales after we post answers. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
support-bot: dpa_kms_questionnaire_acme.pdf (1.2 MB) is now available in the shared thread attachments.
